title: pvp
summary: MSUI implements Benilla's CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP as the exact empty-body toggle verb and routes /pvp through it without producing a chat message. It also strictly decodes the server's fixed 16-byte SMSG_PVP_CREDIT payload and routes positive awards into honor-gained combat text. Server-owned PvP state remains authoritative; live connected verification remains outstanding.

openItems.text: CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP never sent - no way to flip the PvP flag from MSUI
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: opcode 0x0253, empty-body WorldSession/NetworkClient sender, and the client-owned /pvp slash route are implemented with deterministic body coverage.
